as_told.title: Rossi taken by a blue energy humanoid

plain: In 2021, a man named Dave Rossi says he was taken from his home in his sleep by what he calls "a blue energy type humanoid." Rossi tells Michels this as his own experience, on two different episodes, using almost the same words; the second time he gives no date or setting. If true, it would be a direct encounter with a non-human being, the kind of contact Rossi links to the advanced physics he says he was taught.
